channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about John Wall | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about John Wall from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Amen Thompson on LeBron James, Rajon Rondo, John Wall, Russell Westbrook
item.description:
“I also like how they can command the floor. I’ve been a LeBron, Westbrook and John Wall fan. And then I started watching Rondo and was like, ‘Yo, this man is nice.’ “I knew he was nice, but I didn’t know he was that nice,”

Amen Thompson on LeBron James, Rajon Rondo, John Wall, Russell Westbrook, Dec 4, 2025. Source: Andscape.

item.title: Ivica Zubac on John Wall, Russell Westbrook
item.description:
“I think the fit in Phoenix, I don't think it was really good for him. He's got a real point guard now in James and now Chris too. I think that's going to make life so much easier for him. We saw when he played for the Wizards, playing with the real point guard in John Wall and then later with Russell Westbrook, he's a scoring machine. He can get you a 30 points a night, so I think the fit with us is going to be much better and that's going to make life much easier for him.”

Ivica Zubac on John Wall, Russell Westbrook, Sep 23, 2025. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Lawrence Frank on John Wall
item.description:
“Obviously, Brad had great success playing with John Wall [in Washington]. He actually had great success playing with Russ [Westbrook in Washington]. So, we can look at those situations.”

Lawrence Frank on John Wall, Jul 19, 2025. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Stephen Silas on John Wall
item.description:
Stephen Silas on John Wall’s recent comments:

“What John Wall went through here and the situation (he was in) was unprecedented. There was no easy way for it to go down. We tried to make it as good as possible for him as an organization…There’sfrustration and I get it.”

Stephen Silas on John Wall, Jan 18, 2023. Source: Twitter @KellyIko.

item.title: Josh Childress on Zach Randolph, John Wall, Al Harrington
item.description:
“When the opportunity presented itself, the entire ownership group is pretty much based here in LA, guys that I know. Some real estate guys, myself, Al Harrington, Zach Randolph, John Wall, some NBA connectivity, it was a great opportunity for us to take that next step.”

Josh Childress on Zach Randolph, John Wall, Al Harrington, Dec 30, 2022. Source: SiliconValley.com.

item.title: Norman Powell on John Wall
item.description:
Norman Powell on John Wall:

“Me and Luke are probably going to have the most wide open 3s we probably had”

Norman Powell on John Wall, Sep 26, 2022. Source: Twitter @LawMurrayTheNU.

item.title: Lawrence Frank on John Wall
item.description:
“He had a lot to do with getting John Wall to come here… our players had player-led retreats. Paul was huge, him and Kawhi, behind that. The investment he’s made both in the gym, in the weight room, his body looksgreat. Just the urgency that he’s approaching it as one of the leaders and franchise players, you see a lot of growth and development, and just an intensity of his training. I think he’s had an extremely productive offseason.”

Lawrence Frank on John Wall, Sep 22, 2022. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Adam Silver on John Wall
item.description:
Jonathan Feigen:Silver on John Wall:

“Of course I think it's a problem when players are paid not to play.”

Adam Silver on John Wall, Feb 19, 2022. Source: Twitter @Jonathan_Feigen.

item.title: Jalen Green on John Wall
item.description:
Salman Ali:Jalen Green on working with John Wall:

“Yeah that's like my big bro. He gives me a bunch of advice. When we're at the crib, we watch film and stuff together. We break stuff down and watch games.”

Jalen Green on John Wall, Oct 27, 2021. Source: Twitter @SalmanAliNBA.

item.title: Stephen Silas on John Wall
item.description:
Salman Ali:Stephen Silas on John Wall's return:

“He's coming back earlier than expected. I didn't expect him to be here this weekend.”

Stephen Silas on John Wall, Jan 23, 2021. Source: Twitter @SalmanAliNBA.

item.title: Rudy Gay on DeMarcus Cousins, John Wall, David Nwaba
item.description:
Rudy Gay on helping Wall, Cousins & Nwaba overcome Achilles injuries:

“I just want people to do well and have control of their careers. (It's) an injury where people have written you off and told you you can’t come back or it’s career-ending. But if I can do it, they can do it.”

Rudy Gay on DeMarcus Cousins, John Wall, David Nwaba, Jan 14, 2021. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: DeMarcus Cousins on John Wall, James Harden
item.description:
Sam Amick:DeMarcus Cousins:

“My interest is to play with John Wall, to be brutally honest. ...The (Harden) disrespect started way before. This isn't something that, you know, all of a sudden started last night. ...It's completely unfair to the rest of the guys in the locker room.”

DeMarcus Cousins on John Wall, James Harden, Jan 13, 2021. Source: Twitter @sam_amick.

item.title: Stephen Silas on DeMarcus Cousins, John Wall
item.description:
Alykhan Bijani:Stephen Silas:

“During the film, on the court when we were going over the defensive stuff. The whole spirit of the group was really really good, and [DeMarcus Cousins and John Wall] contributed to that for sure.”

Stephen Silas on DeMarcus Cousins, John Wall, Dec 30, 2020. Source: Twitter @Rockets_Insider.

item.title: Christian Wood on John Wall, James Harden
item.description:
Christian Wood on James Harden and John Wall:

“I think playing with those two, they're gonna make me a star. Through practices and one preseason game, we felt the chemistry between each other. We haven't even had a full season together. The sky's the limit for us.”

Christian Wood on John Wall, James Harden, Dec 22, 2020. Source: Twitter @Rockets_Insider.

item.title: DeMarcus Cousins on John Wall, James Harden
item.description:
Salman Ali:DeMarcus Cousins on gaining chemistry with James Harden and John Wall:

“Having more time together in the gym. Obviously James has just joined the team so a lot of things were kind of on the fly last night. Our IQs alone fix a lot of problems.”

DeMarcus Cousins on John Wall, James Harden, Dec 16, 2020. Source: Twitter @SalmanAliNBA.

item.title: DeMarcus Cousins on John Wall, James Harden
item.description:
Michael C. Wright:DeMarcus Cousins on possibilities w/whole H-tine squad:

“I saw the possibilities before we stepped on the floor. Those two guys' [Harden and Wall] track record speaks for itself. Once they get on the same page, sky's the limit.”

DeMarcus Cousins on John Wall, James Harden, Dec 16, 2020. Source: Twitter @mikecwright.

item.title: James Harden on John Wall
item.description:
Alykhan Bijani:James Harden:

“John [Wall] looks like he’s getting back to his normal self. Boogie as well.”

James Harden on John Wall, Dec 16, 2020. Source: Twitter @Rockets_Insider.

item.title: Stephen Silas on John Wall
item.description:
David Hardisty:Silas on John Wall on Friday:

“He was really good. We need to continue to be spaced well so he can take advantage of the gaps and use his strengths well.”

Stephen Silas on John Wall, Dec 13, 2020. Source: Twitter @clutchfans.

item.title: Stephen Silas on John Wall
item.description:
Alykhan Bijani:Stephen Silas on John Wall:

“I'm loving him as a person. I'm loving him as a leader. I'm loving him as a basketball player.”

Stephen Silas on John Wall, Dec 13, 2020. Source: Twitter @Rockets_Insider.

item.title: Eric Gordon on John Wall
item.description:
Salman Ali:Eric Gordon on John Wall:

“We all know he's really fast. He's getting his explosiveness playing above the rim. Physically, he's back to where he's at.”

Eric Gordon on John Wall, Dec 7, 2020. Source: Twitter @SalmanAliNBA.

item.title: Stephen Silas on John Wall
item.description:
Stephen Silas:

“John Wall looks great. Pushing the ball up the floor and getting everybody organized as a point guard does... He's a joy to coach because he's a coach on the floor. But he also allows me to coach him.”

Stephen Silas on John Wall, Dec 7, 2020. Source: Twitter @Rockets_Insider.

item.title: Troy Brown Jr. on John Wall
item.description:
Chase Hughes:Troy Brown Jr. on seeing John Wall get traded:

“For John, I just want to thank him... he never made it seem like it was a dumb question, he was ready to help.”

Troy Brown Jr. on John Wall, Dec 6, 2020. Source: Twitter @ChaseHughesNBCS.

item.title: Bradley Beal on John Wall
item.description:
Fred Katz:Beal on what it’ll be like when he plays John Wall:

“I don’t know, man. I honestly don’t know. My whole career, all I know is John. Like, today was definitely weird. It’ll be different. It’ll be competitive. I know for sure. He’ll probably try to give us 60, but it’ll be love.”

Bradley Beal on John Wall, Dec 4, 2020. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Bradley Beal on John Wall
item.description:
Fred Katz:Bradley Beal on John Wall:

“It’s been an emotional week. Definitely been some tough 24, 48, 72 hours here, just kind of letting it all seep in and realizing that your brother is no longer here with you no more. He’s off to something better.”

Bradley Beal on John Wall, Dec 4, 2020. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Bradley Beal on John Wall
item.description:
Fred Katz:Beal on saying bye to Wall yesterday:

“When we came together and had those conversations, it was the total opposite of the rumors and the noise. It was the total opposite.”

Bradley Beal on John Wall, Dec 4, 2020. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Otto Porter on John Wall
item.description:
KC Johnson:Otto Porter on John Wall:

“He means so much to that community. Me going to Georgetown, it was John's first couple years in DC. Everything that he stood for, the swag that he brought back to the Wizards, the community just loves him. John will always be part of the DC community.”

Otto Porter on John Wall, Dec 4, 2020. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: DeMarcus Cousins on John Wall
item.description:
Alykhan Bijani:DeMarcus Cousins on playing with John Wall:

“We're super excited. There's obviously chemistry between us from our college days... That'sone of my better friends in the NBA.”

DeMarcus Cousins on John Wall, Dec 3, 2020. Source: Twitter @Rockets_Insider.

item.title: Stephen Silas on John Wall
item.description:
Michael C. Wright:Stephen Silas on John Wall's health:

“I dont know much about his health. I know the guys upstairs have been communicating. I'm just kind of waiting on the info,& we'll proceed w/caution, obviously. It really is dependent on performance team, and the evaluation that they have.”

Stephen Silas on John Wall, Dec 3, 2020. Source: Twitter @mikecwright.

item.title: Scott Brooks on John Wall
item.description:
Scott Brooks on John Wall:

“He's as good and strong as he's ever been. He has his speed and strength and his shot looks great.”

Scott Brooks on John Wall, Dec 1, 2020. Source: Twitter @ChaseHughesNBCS.

item.title: Scott Brooks on John Wall
item.description:
Chase Hughes:More Brooks on John Wall:

“That's always the thing that you're worried about, does he have that speed? He has it, I've seen it up close in practice.”

Scott Brooks on John Wall, Dec 1, 2020. Source: Twitter @ChaseHughesNBCS.
